blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 85 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: One file, two views
blocks.body:
The tabs under the page are **Author**, **Text**, and **Grid**.

- **Author** :  looks like a page. This is where you write on most days.
- **Text** :  the same page with **tags** (those angle brackets). The tags are the skeleton of the file.
- **Grid** :  looks a bit like a spreadsheet. You will almost never live here this week. Glance and leave.

Author is not Microsoft Word. If a button on the toolbar is grey, the page type does not allow that thing in that spot. You will feel this later. Today, just switch tabs.

items.title: Word today
items.body:
**Tag** : a label in angle brackets, like `

` around a paragraph. You do not need to memorise a list. You only need to see that Text view is the same file.

items.title: Do not
items.body: Do not delete a closing tag “to see what happens” unless you are ready to Undo. Tomorrow is soon enough for a safe broken file.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You never left Author, or you deleted a tag in Text and left it broken.

Expected: You saw the sentence in Author and in Text. The file still opens.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Find the tabs under the big writing area. They are named Text, Grid, and Author (the order can vary).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Stay in Author. That is the page view. Confirm your sentence from yesterday is still readable as a normal sentence.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Switch to Text. You should see angle brackets around the same words. Do not delete a bracket.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Switch to Grid. It looks a bit like a spreadsheet. Glance, then switch back to Author.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: In oxygen-bootcamp-work/day-03-views.txt write one line: Author looks like a page. Text shows tags.
